name: headless-hero
description: AI-powered video production pipeline for faceless YouTube channels — Headless Hero

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend,electron "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn api.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8420 --reload
